status: FROZEN for review; any change requires a numbered new version approved by the user
estimand: unchanged: day-volatility-weighted pooled variance ratio (RMS volatility) between open, middle, close
statistic: T = max over the 3 pairwise contrasts of |ln(mean_a/mean_b)| / influence-function SE (rom, block 1, as h1_rms2)
baseline_for_comparison: M4b bootstrap-t, B=999, rom, max rule, iid days

candidates.C1: null-imposed model-based bootstrap with empirical bar-level shocks; R=499 artificial datasets; decision p=(1+#{T*>=T})/(R+1)<=alpha; robust (median) day scale; slot profile equalised within period; shocks drawn jointly over stocks from the same period; day scales drawn iid
candidates.C2: fast double bootstrap-t; B=999; one inner resample per outer; adjusted p = share of T** above the (1-p1) quantile of T**, reject if <= alpha (formula recalled from Davidson & MacKinnon 2007; NOT verified against the paper; Stage 1 verifies the implementation on a case with known behaviour)
candidates.C3: fixed critical value per sample size = max over gated development cells of the 95% quantile of T, from a SEPARATE training run (disjoint seeds, 25,000 simulations per cell); no extra margin; evaluated on the upper gates only (conservative benchmark/fallback)

fair_comparison_rules: all candidates and the baseline are run on the SAME simulated dataset (same seed) in every simulation of every cell
same alpha, same cells, same number of simulations, same gates; computing cost is reported for each
no candidate is chosen on one cell, one scenario or on power
selection among candidates that pass the two-sided gates in every gated cell: the simplest; ties broken by cost; power is reported only after calibration passes

gates.tier_A_core (df G,10,6,7): point estimate in [4.5%,5.5%] AND Wilson 95% upper limit <= 6.0%, every cell
gates.tier_B_stress (df 4,5): point estimate in [4.0%,6.0%] AND Wilson 95% upper limit <= 6.5%, every cell
gates.C3_only: upper limits only (point <= 5.5% tier A, <= 6.0% tier B); its conservatism (lowest cell rate) is reported
gates.conditional_behaviour: rejection by leverage quartile and by critical-value quartile: reported, flagged if clearly steeper than the Gaussian reference
gates.numerical: any failure rate above 0.1% needs a pre-specified fallback; denominators reported
gates.basis: stage0_mc_precision.py: 25,000 simulations give 95% joint pass probability for up to ~96 gated cells at a true 5.0% rate (30,000 for 192)
gates.bradley_note: Bradley (1978) liberal band 0.5-1.5 alpha is attested only via secondary sources; the original and any stringent band were NOT verified and are not cited

seeds.rule: per-simulation child SeedSequence passed to default_rng; validation seeds unused until Stage 3

failure_conditions: any tier A cell outside gate on validation
any tier B cell outside gate (domain narrowed to df>=6 and reported)
fitted-parameter instability (critical-value CV of the candidate >= that of the baseline)
power collapse flagged (<70% of baseline power at T4 flat x1.2)
required simulations unreachable within the approved budget
descriptive_real_data_note: descriptive tail/shape summaries only; they place real data on the grid; no H1 test on real data
